ships.name: Tide of Memory
ships.description: Originally covenant founder Solving Epicurusson's ship; inherited by Dagmar after Solving vanished into Twilight (1220). Carries Solving's summoning bell and astrolabe, and the covenant's magical Master Chart, which tracks the whole fleet's positions. The covenant's mobile library is also housed aboard. Captained by Absalom, who previously captained the Maelstrom's Maw.

ships.name: Brineborn
ships.description: Éogan's ship, under sailing-captain Rembrant de Wees. As of Fall 1223, the vessel carrying the party's Ireland expedition.

ships.name: Adamant
ships.description: Valerian's ship — confirmed to be the fleet's fifth hull, commissioned at Bergen and given to Valerian on his arrival in 1222.

ships.name: Veðrdreki
ships.description: Valdemar's personal Viking drakar — distinct from the main covenant fleet, used mainly for river/inland transit (e.g. up the Sarthe to Le Mans in Summer 1223).

ships.name: The Scholar's Wake
ships.description: Dustin's ship and the covenant's main trade vessel — recruited Stijntje aboard in 1220; worked with merchant-agent Heynric the Merchant. Home to Rosie the pig and Dustin's apprentice.

ships.name: The Gloaming
ships.status: No longer part of the covenant
ships.description: A former covenant ship, no longer with the fleet. Circumstances of its departure not yet recorded.

ships.name: Maelstrom's Maw
ships.owner: formerly Nequam of Tytalus, then Kor Ex Flambeau
ships.description: Nequam's ship, handed to Kor Ex Flambeau in Summer 1220. Survived a sky-ship crash during a meteor storm (Winter 1220-21), but confirmed missing — the ship never came in, and the covenant's Master Chart no longer tracks it. No longer part of the covenant's active fleet. Its captain, Absalom, moved on to captain the Tide of Memory.

ships.name: Hound of Cassel
ships.aka: the Tremere ship, formerly Scarem Montem's
ships.description: Confirmed: this is the ship pirated from Scarem Montem — a Tremere-crewed vessel, raided by Valdemar's crew in Summer 1221. Yielded three magically-sealed chests and the letter that led to discovering the imprisoned Valerian de Castellane. As of Spring 1224, it's under Wilhelm's control and heading back to Scarem Montem — handing them back their own hull as the trade chip for his stolen thesis.

Dagmar.note: De facto covenant leader. Inherited the Tide of Memory from his vanished parens, Solving.

Dustin Page.note: Trade-minded; owns the Scholar's Wake; teaching apprentice Stijntje.

Éogan Dobhartha.note: From Connacht, Hibernia; a hostage-exchange hedge-magic background. Owns the Brineborn.

Valdemar Bjornsson.note: Skyclad Viking war-magus; centuries-old survivor of a regio. Married to Rán. Owns Veðrdreki (the Storm Dragon).

Wilhelm Stienauer.affiliation: Rhine Tribunal (Durenmar) — not yet a Sjórseiðr member
Wilhelm Stienauer.note: Folk-magic thesis researcher; his stolen Latin thesis copy is held by Scarem Montem. Set to gain the Hound of Cassel.

Valerian de Castellane.note: Rescued from imprisonment by the Duke of Brabant; politically dangerous, runs unilateral side-deals. Owns the Adamant.

Rán.note: A deep-sea Drifter (fae); passes among Hermetic society with a Presence+Guile stress die.

Stijntje Kuiper.note: Recruited aboard the Scholar's Wake, 1220. Ran away from a noble household.

Hilda.note: Organizational spine of Wilhelm's thesis-review process.

Karl.note: One of two field researchers who study folk practitioners in situ.

Dietrich.note: Professor of medicine and philosophy at a Cologne cathedral school; a gifted rhetorician defending the folk-magic thesis.

Drest.note: Combat/distraction grog; tackled opposing melee defenders at the Tribunal.

Angus McPeterson.note: "Completely legitimate sailor"; home-circle defender in the Tribunal grog melee.

Garrat Coffin.note: Fought in the Hound of Cassel raid and the grog melee. Transferred from the Brineborn to Veðrdreki before the Hound of Cassel capture (the chronicle's older text tying him to the Brineborn predates that transfer).

Giden.note: Rode with Valdemar's Hound of Cassel piracy raid.

Ka'wa'ill.note: Also rode with Valdemar's piracy raid.

Henri (failed apprentice).note: A failed apprentice; Dustin plans to learn Teaching from him.

Father Lachlan.note: Cheerful and curious; has taken to life among magi with unusual ease.

Kor Ex Flambeau.note: Last known working on a giant hovering stone platform; missing along with the ship.

Caris.note: Dagmar's Dimicatio-final rival, now a prickly mentor-in-residence at Oleron. Lent Dagmar a personal text, "Erroneous Meditations on the Enigma," that turned out to be an unusually detailed account of someone who vanished and returned.

Rody.affiliation: Handed off near Cruachan, en route to the Hermetic covenant near the Hill of Uisneach
Rody.note: About eight and a half, talkative and unbothered. Éogan identified him as a changeling via Fairy Lore; the real Gifted child he replaced is still unaccounted for.

Absalom.note: Previously captained the Maelstrom's Maw; now captains the Tide of Memory under Dagmar.

Nequam of Tytalus.note: Original owner of the Maelstrom's Maw before handing it to Kor Ex Flambeau.

snapshots.label: Summer 1223 — sailing for the Tribunal
snapshots.note: Veðrdreki (the Storm Dragon) carried the party inland from the coast up the Sarthe to Le Mans; a temporary boarding, not each grog's standing ship — see the "All Ships" tab for regular crew assignments.

snapshots.label: Fall 1223 — the post-Tribunal split
snapshots.note: After the Tribunal's close, the covenant split three ways: north to Dragon's Rest/Scarem Montem/Ireland, a rendezvous run to Dragon's Rest, and Dagmar's solo winter at Oleron.

assignments.note: Plus one of Wilhelm's two research assistants (Karl or the unnamed one — not specified which). Drops Éogan/Dustin/Stijntje/Wilhelm/Hilda just past Dublin, then continues (crew only) up to Drogheda to shorten their walk, before wintering itself at the Isle of Man — reconvening with the overland party back in Dublin once the ice breaks.
Sailing alongside the Brineborn, not aboard it. Same drop-off near Dublin, then winters (crew only) at the Isle of Man with the Brineborn.
Plus Wilhelm's other research assistant (whichever one didn't travel on the Brineborn) toward a rendezvous at Dragon's Rest.
Sails to Oleron, where Dagmar winters in person; the ship returns for him in spring 1224.
No explicit travel plan recorded for Valdemar this leg — presumed to remain with his own ship.

snapshots.label: Spring 1224 — thaw and pickups (in progress)
snapshots.note: Still developing at the table as of the 2026-07-11 session — treat as provisional. Dagmar heads north from Oleron working vis sources and a new regio lead solo with grogs by rowboat; Éogan/Dustin/Stijntje start back through Cruachan toward Dublin, now with a changeling child, Rody, in tow.

assignments.note: Falcon's Cliff harvest, then a solo rowboat exploration (with grogs, not the ship itself) of a newly discovered regio in sea caves near Carnac.

Return leg through Cruachan toward Dublin to reconvene with the ships once the ice breaks — now traveling with Rody, a changeling child being delivered to the Hermetic covenant near the Hill of Uisneach.
Heading back to Scarem Montem — returning the ship itself as the trade chip for Wilhelm's stolen thesis.
